content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"P012","reason":"Designs motors, drives and motion controllers sold to equipment makers in industrial, medical and aerospace markets, matching AMETEK's motion control and motor lines."},{"label":"P132","reason":"Makes utility meters, power test equipment, filtration and aerospace components for utilities, OEMs and defense, overlapping AMETEK's instruments and defense electronics."},{"label":"P219","reason":"Designs and services radiation detection and measurement instruments for nuclear, medical and defense customers, with calibration and maintenance as in AMETEK's test instrument business."},{"label":"P357","reason":"Sells analytical and water quality instruments, sensors and calibration services to industrial manufacturers and utilities, close to AMETEK's process instruments."},{"label":"P359","reason":"Sells network test and measurement instruments and aerospace and defense test equipment, similar to AMETEK's test and calibration equipment for defense and industry."},{"label":"P191","reason":"Makes pumps, valves, connectors and sensors for industrial and aerospace OEMs, with aftermarket service, overlapping parts of AMETEK's electromechanical and sensor lines."},{"label":"P089","reason":"Designs aerospace components, sensors and industrial valves and pumps sold to aerospace, defense and process plant customers, partly overlapping AMETEK's end markets and products."}]}
